messages:
Alex: quick q — opened a small PR that touches /runtime/* and /services/model-service/*. CODEOWNERS seems fuzzy for model-service after the repo move. who can approve cross-area changes? aiming for tomorrow cutoff 15:00 PT.
Jamie: sounds like a codeowners gap. if model-service has no owner listed it becomes an orphaned path. @codeowner-bot can you show matches?
codeowner-bot: MATCHES: /runtime/** -> @eng-runtime; /services/model-service/** -> NO MATCH (no CODEOWNERS entry)
Sophia: I historically reviewed model-service but moved teams recently. I'm on review rotation this week — I can approve if the change is small. please add a short risk checklist in the PR and mark anything that affects public APIs.
Alex: thanks. PR is 4 files: import path updates + one kernel tweak in runtime runner. will add checklist. splitting feels risky for this release.
Tyler: I can review the runtime side. if it touches model serving APIs we should also get an eng-platform approver. @Jamie — does this look like platform-level signoff?
Jamie: yes — runtime kernel + service surface = platform concern. process I'd follow: runtime owner + model owner (Sophia) + eng-platform approver. since CODEOWNERS doesn't match model-service we should add an exception or temporary approver. @Alex add an explicit request-for-approval tag and ping @Tyler and @Sophia.
Alex: done — pinging @Tyler @Sophia please review before 14:00 PT if possible, cutoff 15:00.
Tyler: will review now. likely ask for one small unit test or a revert-safe flag. if we can't merge before cutoff we hold to next patch.
Sophia: :thumbsup: I'll take a look after lunch. if I see API-level changes I'll request a short design sync (15m).
Alex: also filing a CODEOWNERS exception to avoid this in future. @codeowner-bot please open PR adding @Sophia to /services/model-service/*
codeowner-bot: Opened PR: github.com/redwood-inference/.github/CODEOWNERS#1234 — adds @Sophia to /services/model-service/* (reviewers: @eng-platform)
oncall-bot: reminder — maintenance window today 16:00-17:00 PT, avoid infra restarts during window :warning:
Alex: thanks everyone. i'll wait for both approvals, if both green by 14:30 PT i'll merge and monitor metrics. otherwise we'll push to next patch and document reasoning in PR.
